wiki.title: Beryl Amedee
wiki.extract: Beryl Adams Amedée (born October 14, 1964) is an American politician and businesswoman serving as a member of the Louisiana House of Representatives from the 51st district. Elected in November 2015, she assumed office on January 11, 2016. She is the Chairwoman of the Louisiana Freedom Caucus.
